# Kraftika Studio

> Kraftika Studio is an Indian direct-to-consumer brand making premium handcrafted scented candles. All candles are hand-poured in small batches using 100% natural soy wax, lead-free cotton wicks and fine fragrance oils, and are shipped across India (free shipping over ₹500). Founded by candlemaker Anamika Sinha.

Key facts:
- Products: scented soy candles in Sweet, Fresh, Floral and Woody scent families
- Price range: roughly ₹300–₹600 per candle; burn time 40–45 hours typical
- Made in: India, hand-poured in small batches
- Materials: natural soy wax (no paraffin), cotton wicks, eco-friendly packaging
- Shipping: pan-India; free above ₹500, ₹50 below
- Returns: 7-day return window after delivery
- Payments: UPI, cards (Razorpay) and Cash on Delivery
- Contact: studiokraftika@gmail.com
